description:
Open spatial data for Scotland, mirrored from NatureScot and Scottish Forestry: the statutory nature conservation designations, the wider landscape and greenspace mapping, the national woodland inventories with the forestry regulatory and grant record, and the marine protected areas. Every dataset is published under the Open Government Licence v3.0 and discovered through Scotland's Spatial Data Discovery portal.

**Disclaimer:** a demonstration of Portolan as cloud-native infrastructure for disseminating open geodatasets. This catalog republishes data from its original publishers in cloud-native formats such as GeoParquet and PMTiles, with STAC metadata — open, standards-based and freely accessible to everyone. It is not an official service of the original publishers, which remain the authoritative source.
title: Scotland Spatial Data
